# PITSIKY Art Gallery (بيتسيكي)

> PITSIKY (بيتسيكي) is a Moroccan online store for premium wall art and wall decor: high-quality art prints in multiple sizes starting from 249 MAD (30x40 cm), free delivery to every city in Morocco, and custom poster design on request. The site is Arabic-first and also available in English.

## Key facts
- Starting price: 249 MAD for a 30x40 cm print; larger sizes (40x60, 50x70, 60x90, 80x120 cm) cost more. Prices are in Moroccan dirhams (MAD / DH).
- Delivery: free to all Moroccan cities, usually 3–5 business days after order confirmation.
- Payment: 50% upfront to confirm the order, 50% on delivery. The team phones the customer to confirm.
- Exchange: within 7 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging; damaged or misprinted items are replaced free of charge (report within 48 hours with a photo).
- Custom designs: send an idea at https://www.pitsiky.com/custom or on WhatsApp +212 702 382 376.
- Contact: hello@pitsiky.com · WhatsApp +212 702 382 376 · Casablanca, Morocco.

## Shop
- [All wall art](https://www.pitsiky.com/shop): the complete catalog with prices.
- [Collections](https://www.pitsiky.com/collections): wall art grouped by theme (cars, anime, Islamic art, modern decor and more).
- [Custom poster design](https://www.pitsiky.com/custom): order a personalised print.
